title: Data-driven achievements with Terraria-style popups
player_outcome: Terraria-style achievements ('Timber!!', 'Benched', 'Ooo! Shiny!', 'No Hobo', 'Eye on You', 'Hold on Tight!'...) unlock as you play, with a popup, icon and sound, and are remembered per character.
design: New content category 'achievements' (AchievementDef: Id, Name, Description, Icon (item id), Category (explorer|collector|slayer|challenger), TypedSpec Trigger, int? Target). Registry in ContentDatabase, reader in ContentLoader, a new SpecKind.AchievementTrigger, and validation in a new ContentValidator.Guide.cs.

Trigger types (params classes in Content/Specs/AchievementSpecs.cs): flag{id}; obtainItem{item|tag|category}; craftItem{item|tag}; killEnemy{enemy|tag, count}; mineBlock{block|tag, count}; breakObject{tag, count}; housed{min}; rescued{id?}; bestiary{percent}; anglerQuests{min}; talkTo{resident}; buy{count}; reforge{count}; coins{min}; reachLayer{layer}; counter{key, min}.

New Gameplay/Guide/AchievementTracker.cs in GameWorld. On Journal.Changed(kind, key) it evaluates only triggers indexed by kind (Dictionary<string kind, List<def>>); state triggers (coins, housed, bestiary, reachLayer) are swept at 1 Hz. On unlock it writes Journal.Achievements[id] = now and raises Unlocked(PlayerEntity, AchievementDef). Progress(def, journal) → (current, target) for the book.

Data data/achievements.json: about 40 Terraria achievements that map to implemented mechanics (author from the wiki list; skip those needing absent features). Probes achievement.<id> (1/0), and command 'achievement grant <id>'.

Popup: game/UI/AchievementToast.cs, a CanvasLayer with a top-centre panel ('Achievement complete!' in Terraria gold, the name, the item icon). Queued, 4 s each, with a slide-in tween, pooled controls and a UiTheme panel. A chat line if the UI phase's ChatLog exists.
Sound: add an 'achievement' SFX recipe to tools/audio/sfx_recipes.py and regenerate with tools/audio/build_audio.py.
files_modify: src/Strata.Core/Session/GameWorld.PlayerFiles.cs or a GameWorld.Guide.cs partial — Achievements property
tests: AchievementTests: crafting work_bench unlocks 'benched' once; killEnemy count progress 3/10; flag trigger on defeated_eye_of_cthulhu; persistence through PlayerSave; the validator rejects an unknown item in a trigger
Smoke guide.cmds: 'give wood 20' / 'place work_bench 2 0 0'? — no: 'craft work_bench' / 'assert achievement.benched == 1'
verification: dotnet test; validate; guide.cmds PASS; in game the toast shows once with sound
risks: Achievement names are Terraria's; the 'covers' links need reference concepts (add an 'achievements' reference category, or omit covers).
